title: Simple Glance
description: A simple mod to get more info on what you are looking at.
body:
# Simple Glance

> **Know what you're looking at — instantly.**

Simple Glance adds a clean, minimal HUD overlay to the top of your screen that tells you exactly what block or entity your crosshair is pointing at — no more guessing, no more opening wikis.

---

## ✨ Features

- **Block & fluid identification** — shows the name of any block you're looking at
- **Entity identification** — shows the name and type of any mob or entity
- **Item icons** — displays the block or spawn egg icon right next to the name
- **Mob health bar** — a colour-coded health bar shows how much HP a mob has left, along with the exact numbers
- **Break progress bar** — an orange bar fills the bottom of the panel as you mine a block, showing how close you are to breaking it
- **Clean & minimal** — a panel that stays out of your way, hides when menus are open or the HUD is toggled off

---

## 🎨 Colour coding

| Colour | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| ⬜ White | Blocks |
| 🟡 Gold | Entities |
| 🟢 Green | High health |
| 🟡 Yellow | Medium health |
| 🔴 Red | Low health |
| 🟠 Orange | Block break progress |

---
Notice:
This mod can and WILL NOT be shared without consent from me, credit would be nice.
